case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

You wrote that you are eager to prove yourselves as a long-term partner, and Option A is where that starts: a firm quality commitment that you can stand behind, with no chargeback on any complaint.

Option A is the package we can approve. Your quality record and our order history set the frame for it, and Option A turns that into a commitment that works for both sides.

On quality:
Your quality was 2376 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

On the cost side:
German electricity producer prices changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 39.85.
Option B: quality commitment 800 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.18.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.41.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. You asked what we need to confirm: we need this price and for you to pay faster, since late payments really hurt our cash flow. Electricity went down a bit, but we can only drop the price to 46.50 EUR for this package. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

Our offer is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: €46.50 per unit, a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

You said late payments really hurt your cash flow, and you are right to raise it: we will pay every invoice on its agreed due date under Option A.

Thank you for checking our earlier points and taking them into account. Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you a clear quality target to build to and no chargeback on any complaint, and it gives us the steady, dependable supply we want from a casting partner.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.54.
Option B: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 300.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.63.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 150.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.59.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Options B and C are there for your convenience if you prefer to carry some chargeback, but Option A is the one we will take forward.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
